description: Railway Node is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ordnance Survey. A point spatial object that is used to break up the Railway Network for connectivity. The Railway Network splits for the following circumstances: The location where an attribute changes The intersection or crossing of Railway Links The start / end of a Railway Link. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Ordnance Survey. The portal shows 2025-01-10 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
